data.one_liner: A Persian (Jalali, Shamsi) date and time picker for Flutter, inspired by Material Design.
data.what_it_does: Provides fully customizable Material and Cupertino date and time pickers for the Persian (Jalali) calendar. It supports multiple languages including Persian, Dari, Kurdish, and Pashto, alongside Material 3 compatibility.
use_when: You need to collect Persian (Jalali) dates and times in a Flutter app.
Your app requires localization for Persian, Dari, Pashto, or Kurdish calendars.
avoid_when: Your app exclusively uses the Gregorian calendar.
You are not using the Flutter framework.
strengths: Full support for the Persian (Jalali) calendar and holidays
Multi-language support for Persian, Dari, Kurdish, and Pashto
weaknesses: Limited to specific calendars like Jalali
Requires manual addition of localizations delegates to MaterialApp
data.setup_notes: Add the dependency to pubspec.yaml and configure the localization delegates in your MaterialApp.
